goal: Make APEA-G a bounded, evidence-driven, continuously executing engineering agent that plans once, advances on GREEN, repairs on RED, preserves state across interruptions, and safely completes the GitHub lifecycle.

steps.goal: Survive provider authentication, authorization, rate-limit, timeout, outage, and model failures without losing the active plan.
acceptance: provider outage becomes resumable BLOCKED state

steps.goal: Make plan and execution state durable, versioned, atomic, idempotent, and restart-safe.
acceptance: duplicate events do not repeat a step

steps.goal: Generate and validate one complete bounded engineering plan with dependencies and acceptance criteria before execution.
Turn GitHub CI into structured evidence for diagnosis and advancement.
acceptance: failed jobs and steps are collected

steps.goal: Execute exactly one coherent plan step per cycle with repository-aware auditing and strict change boundaries.
Automatically diagnose and repair RED from actual CI evidence with bounded attempts and failure memory.
Complete safe branch, PR, CI, merge, and post-merge continuation without user GREEN/RED interaction.
acceptance: main is protected from direct agent writes
successful plans can merge and resume

steps.goal: Prevent secret exposure, safety-policy weakening, destructive commands, test weakening, and unsafe self-modification.
Require meaningful quality, regression, architecture, security, and evaluation evidence before declaring a capability complete.
acceptance: GREEN CI alone is not treated as completion

steps.goal: Close the autonomous loop so successful completion immediately selects the next unfinished capability and provider/CI interruptions resume automatically.
acceptance: plan completion starts the next eligible cycle
human input is reserved for explicit safety/ambiguity gates
